note: UI Styles Layout Builder adds ui_styles_styles selectors to Layout Builder's Configure section form (section + one per region) and to block-component config. Section styles are stored on the Section object third-party settings (ui_styles provider): 'selected'/'extra' for the section, 'regions' map for regions (schema layout_builder.section.third_party.ui_styles). Component styles: SectionComponent keys ui_styles_<part> and ui_styles_<part>_extra. Sections live in an entity override or in core.entity_view_display.<...> defaults. Classes injected at render by BlockComponentRenderArraySubscriber / EntityViewAlter / PreprocessBlock via addClasses(). Medium/hard cases are grounded in a real LB-enabled node.page.default display and its first section.

evals.prompt: With UI Styles Layout Builder, which parts of a Layout Builder layout can I apply UI Styles classes to?
evals.expected_output: Three targets: the whole section, each region inside a section, and individual block components placed in the layout. Selectors are added to Layout Builder's Configure section form and to block-component config forms.

evals.prompt: In UI Styles Layout Builder, where on a Layout Builder Section object are the chosen section and region styles stored?
evals.expected_output: On the Section's third-party settings under the 'ui_styles' provider: 'selected' and 'extra' for the section, and a 'regions' map (region name => {selected, extra}) for regions. Schema type layout_builder.section.third_party.ui_styles.

evals.prompt: How does UI Styles Layout Builder actually add the configured classes to the rendered section, region and block markup?
evals.expected_output: At render time it calls StylePluginManager::addClasses() from an event subscriber (BlockComponentRenderArraySubscriber) for components and from EntityViewAlter / PreprocessBlock for sections, regions and blocks, injecting the classes onto the appropriate render arrays.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the node 'page' default view display uses Layout Builder and its first section has a UI Styles section-level style applied. Inspect the live layout and give the extra CSS class on that section.
evals.expected_output: The class is ui-styles-eval-lb: in core.entity_view_display.node.page.default the first Layout Builder Section has third_party_settings.ui_styles.extra = 'ui-styles-eval-lb'. Load the display, get the section, then $section->getThirdPartySetting('ui_styles','extra').

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the node 'page' default display uses Layout Builder with one section. Using UI Styles Layout Builder, apply the CSS class 'ui-styles-eval-lb2' as a section-level style on that first section, and save it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: On the first Section of core.entity_view_display.node.page.default set $section->setThirdPartySetting('ui_styles','extra','ui-styles-eval-lb2') (or add it via selected), then save the display (or use the Configure section form's UI Styles Extra classes field).
